If you share our vision and would like to contribute to better research and a positive research culture, then feel free to contact us and become a contributor of the MERRI Collaboration.

Find our definition of contribution in our Terms of Reference. Fill in the [following form](https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=6ZI8Da53SU-9Em_yno8cN3BwvRSFOJxMsta4_GGcyYlUNkVPSlQxVFRFMjY2UlVFOTFBUlkyRUVSUiQlQCN0PWcu) to let us know that you are interested in joining us.
